description: One entry per spreadsheet that scripts/sheet_io.py converts between XLSX (for people) and JSON (for scripts and agents). Columns, required cells and allowed values live here, not in code. `xlsx`, `json` and `audit` name constants in scripts/paths.py. A column with "in_json": false is kept in the spreadsheet only.

ai_areas.json_description: AI areas of the AI RMF assessment: the ways AI is used and the components of the AI ecosystem, each with the attack areas it impacts. Generated from data/ai/authoring/ai_areas.xlsx by scripts/sheet_io.py import; the spreadsheet is the decision, edit it, not this file. Model: AI_RMF_Mapping_Sheet_Design.md.

columns.help: Short lowercase id, letters, digits and _ only. The intake menus use it; never reuse an id for a different area.
Plain name of the way AI is used, or of the part of the AI ecosystem.
usage: a way AI is used (or used around you). component: a part of the AI ecosystem.
Which question bank: consumer, producer or both.

The attack areas a failure here hits, one or more: data (exposed, leaked, poisoned), access (permissions and credentials used or abused), process (a business process or decision goes wrong), assets (model, code or infrastructure stolen, damaged or taken down).
What is exposed and what can go wrong. The agents that draft the mapping read this.
One question that shows the area, for people reading the sheet. Not copied to the JSON.

readme: AI areas of the AI RMF assessment: how AI is used (usage) and what the AI is made of (component), and which attack areas each one impacts.
This spreadsheet is the decision. Scripts never read it directly: after editing, run
which checks every row and writes data/ai/ai_areas.json. If anything is wrong it lists the problems and writes nothing.
The freshness check reports this sheet as stale until it has been imported.
Which areas a client gets comes from the intake: the usage and component menus list these ids, and data/ai/scope_rules.json (ai_area_rules) adds the automatic ones.
Each area is checked through the four AI RMF functions (GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, MANAGE) in the mapping step; see AI_RMF_Mapping_Sheet_Design.md.
Dropdowns limit Kind and Applies to; Impact takes one or more of data, access, process, assets separated by commas. Column help is below.
